title: Shenqi compound ameliorates renal fibrosis in diabetic kidney disease by inhibiting LRG1/TGF-beta/Smad signaling pathway.
authors: Yuan, Yun; Liu, Lu; Chen, Nianzhi; Tang, Shiyun; Qi, Yulin
journal: Phytomedicine : international journal of phytotherapy and phytopharmacology
one_liner_zh: 该文研究中药复方通过小分子TAN IIA与LRG1蛋白结合抑制TGF-beta/Smad通路改善糖尿病肾病纤维化，虽涉及分子对接与MD模拟，但核心是药物-蛋白互作而非TF-DNA体系，方法可迁移但对象偏离。
abstract: BACKGROUND: Diabetic kidney disease (DKD) is one of the most common microvascular complications of diabetes. The progression of DKD to end-stage renal disease (ESRD) is characterized by glomerulosclerosis and tubulointerstitial fibrosis. Under hyperglycemic conditions, renal tubular epithelial cells undergo extracellular matrix (ECM) deposition, which ultimately leads to renal fibrosis. Current therapeutic strategies for DKD are confronted with tough challenges such as lack of specific therapy and multiple adverse effects. Shenqi Compound (SQ), a traditional Chinese medicine compound formula, has demonstrated favorable treatment effect in diabetes. However, the potential therapeutic effects of SQ on DKD and ECM deposition remain insufficiently explored. PURPOSE: This study aimed to investigate the role of SQ in alleviating DKD and elucidated its underlying mechanisms in ECM deposition associated with DKD. METHODS: In vivo experiments, a DKD rat model was established by high-fat diet feeding and intraperitoneal injection of streptozotocin. Different concentrations of SQ were administered by oral gavage for 10 weeks, with irbesartan (Avapro) used as a positive control. Renal pathological injuries were assessed using HE, PAS and Masson staining. Disease indicators and levels of pathway-associated proteins were detected via IHC, WB and ELISA. The active ingredients of SQ were identified using LC-MS/MS. Network pharmacology analysis, bioinformatics analysis, molecular docking, and molecular dynamics simulation were employed to validate the interaction between the active component of SQ, Tanshinone IIA (TAN IIA), and leucine-rich alpha-2-glycoprotein 1 (LRG1). In vitro experiments, human renal tubular epithelial cells (HK-2) were stimulated with TGF-beta1 to induce ECM deposition. The effects of TAN IIA on LRG1/TGF-beta/Smad signaling pathway-driven renal ECM deposition were evaluated using CCK-8 assay, wound healing assay, WB, and cell immunofluorescence. RESULTS: Animal experiments results demonstrated that SQ ameliorated blood glucose, body weight, and renal pathological injury in DKD rats. SQ suppressed the activation of the LRG1/TGF-beta/Smad signaling pathway, thereby effectively attenuated renal ECM deposition and kidney fibrosis. The active ingredient TAN IIA and DKD-associated pathway target LRG1 were identified through LC-MS/MS and database analysis. Molecular docking, molecular dynamics simulations, and small molecule-protein binding experiments confirmed that TAN IIA stably bind to LRG1 and inhibited LRG1 protein activity. Cell experiments demonstrated that TAN IIA exhibited no significant cytotoxicity to HK-2, suppressed cell migration, and inhibited the activation of LRG1/TGF-beta/Smad signaling pathway. CONCLUSION: Our study demonstrated that SQ may ameliorate ECM-related renal fibrosis in DKD by inhibiting the LRG1/TGF-beta/Smad signaling pathway. The active ingredient of SQ, TAN IIA, bind to the LRG1 in a targeted manner, suppressing LRG1 activity and exerting anti-fibrotic effects. These findings provide a more sufficient theoretical foundation for the clinical application of SQ in DKD treatment.
abstract_zh: 背景：糖尿病肾病（DKD）是糖尿病最常见的微血管并发症之一。DKD进展为终末期肾病（ESRD）的特征是肾小球硬化和肾小管间质纤维化。在高血糖条件下，肾小管上皮细胞发生细胞外基质（ECM）沉积，最终导致肾纤维化。目前针对DKD的治疗策略面临缺乏特异性疗法和多种不良反应等严峻挑战。参芪复方（SQ）作为一种中药复方制剂，在糖尿病治疗中已显示出良好的疗效。然而，SQ对DKD及ECM沉积的潜在治疗作用尚未得到充分探索。目的：本研究旨在探讨SQ在缓解DKD中的作用，并阐明其在DKD相关ECM沉积中的潜在机制。方法：在体内实验中，通过高脂饮食喂养和腹腔注射链脲佐菌素建立DKD大鼠模型。以不同浓度的SQ灌胃给药10周，以厄贝沙坦（Avapro）作为阳性对照。采用HE、PAS和Masson染色评估肾病理损伤。通过IHC、WB和ELISA检测疾病指标及通路相关蛋白水平。利用LC-MS/MS鉴定SQ的活性成分。采用网络药理学分析、生物信息学分析、分子对接和分子动力学模拟验证SQ活性成分丹参酮IIA（TAN IIA）与富含亮氨酸α-2糖蛋白1（LRG1）之间的相互作用。在体外实验中，用人肾小管上皮细胞（HK-2）经TGF-β1刺激诱导ECM沉积。使用CCK-8实验、划痕愈合实验、WB和细胞免疫荧光评估TAN IIA对LRG1/TGF-β/Smad信号通路驱动的肾ECM沉积的影响。结果：动物实验结果表明，SQ改善了DKD大鼠的血糖、体重和肾病理损伤。SQ抑制了LRG1/TGF-β/Smad信号通路的激活，从而有效减轻了肾ECM沉积和肾纤维化。通过LC-MS/MS和数据库分析鉴定了活性成分TAN IIA和DKD相关通路靶点LRG1。分子对接、分子动力学模拟和小分子-蛋白质结合实验证实，TAN IIA能稳定结合LRG1并抑制LRG1蛋白活性。细胞实验表明，TAN IIA对HK-2无明显细胞毒性，抑制细胞迁移，并抑制LRG1/TGF-β/Smad信号通路的激活。结论：本研究表明，SQ可能通过抑制LRG1/TGF-β/Smad信号通路改善DKD中ECM相关肾纤维化。SQ的活性成分TAN IIA以靶向方式结合LRG1，抑制LRG1活性并发挥抗纤维化作用。这些发现为SQ在DKD治疗中的临床应用提供了更充分的理论基础。
